title: La patente (2)
author: Luigi Pirandello
note: Chiàrchiaro, the man the whole town believes has the evil eye, now stands in judge D'Andrea's office, and he has a surprising request. The story uses the passato remoto: when you hear "disse" or "fu", think "said", "was". "Jettatore" is the man with the evil eye, and "jettatura" the evil eye itself; "patente" means licence.
